_readme: Your look. Every style reads these instead of the reference orange. accent replaces the reference orange everywhere (italic serif key words, glows, active rows, filled grid cells); accentLight is for text or fills on black that need to read brighter; accentDeep for glows and card tints. success/loss stay green/red because they carry meaning. Fonts are defaults until you pick your own.

palette._readme: The company colours, from the VSL. Use these names everywhere (captions, reels, graphics, thumbnails, carousels). Rules: styles/PALETTE.md. Picture: styles/brand-palette.png

captions._readme: Pick by what is behind the words. On Bryan's purple-lit set, purple key words disappear, so use gold.
